### VirtualEyes

**Categories:** Monitoring, metrics, logs and tracing<br>
**Roles:** Site Reliability Engineer, Observability Engineer<br>
**Model:** Free Saas<br>
**Status:** Active

Hosted monitoring service for website and server uptime, DNS records, certificates, domains, and scheduled-job heartbeats.

**Use when**

- You want a hosted external monitor with a free entry point and common notification integrations.

**Consider alternatives when**

- You require self-hosting, internal telemetry correlation, or control over the monitoring data plane.

[Official site](https://virtualeyes.io/)

### Zabbix

**Categories:** Monitoring, metrics, logs and tracing<br>
**Roles:** DevOps Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer, Observability Engineer<br>
**Model:** Oss<br>
**Status:** Needs Review

Enterprise-grade monitoring platform (metrics, triggers, dashboards).

**Use when**

- Large-scale traditional infra monitoring with templates and agent support.

**Consider alternatives when**

- Your workload is fully cloud-native and you prefer PromQL/OTel standards.

[Official site](https://www.zabbix.com) · [Source repository](https://github.com/zabbix/zabbix)

### Zipkin

**Categories:** Monitoring, metrics, logs and tracing<br>
**Roles:** DevOps Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer, Observability Engineer<br>
**Model:** Oss<br>
**Status:** Needs Review

Distributed tracing system.

**Use when**

- Simple, lightweight distributed tracing for Java-centric stacks.

**Consider alternatives when**

- Jaeger or OTel Collector already serves as your tracing backend.

[Official site](https://zipkin.io) · [Source repository](https://github.com/openzipkin/zipkin)
